static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.family_status: Has a brother living in the UK; has friends and family who can provide support
static_traits.social_status: Social support generally exists, but communication and contact with relatives and friends have decreased due to increased stress
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of psychotherapy or psychiatric visits
static_traits.language_features: Concrete and clear expression, organized thinking; able to describe the sources and impact of anxiety, cooperation acceptable; overall negative tone, prone to using catastrophic and fortune-telling expressions

basic_info.main_problem: Due to a recent decline in business sales, I have significant anxiety and stress; I tend to catastrophize the problem, believing the decline will last all year, and it has caused sleep disturbance and reduced appetite.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling due to declining sales and overwhelming anxiety; hopes to receive support and guidance in stress management.

core_beliefs: Once a decline occurs, the situation will continue to worsen and ultimately lead to failure
Facing an uncertain environment, I cannot effectively control outcomes, and bad things are often unavoidable

special_situations.event: Last week, saw a sales report showing a marked decline in sales
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If sales show a marked decline, it means the trend will keep worsening and ultimately lead to business failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Fixates on data, works overtime brainstorming marketing and promotion plans, trying to turn the situation around immediately
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will last all year; my shop may not be able to hold on

special_situations.event: Thinking about the current uncertain economic environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: In an uncontrollable larger environment, no matter how hard I try it is useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on external factors and worries repeatedly, hesitating and procrastinating in action
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If the economy goes on like this I am powerless; things will only get worse

special_situations.event: Occasionally business is better or positive feedback is received from customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A brief good situation is only accidental, cannot change the overall trend
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or devalues positive information and continues to focus on negative evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These good reviews do not count; things will decline again soon

special_situations.event: Friends or family provide support and advice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not have worries as strong as mine, it means they do not understand me and cannot help
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication to avoid being seen as complaining; withdraws socially
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not truly understand how serious this matter is, telling them is useless anyway

core_conflict.wish: Longing to control business stability, gain others' understanding and practical support
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure and bankruptcy, losing control, and being negated by others or not understood
defense_goal: Maintains vigilance and a sense of control by anticipating the worst and generalizing threats, reducing disappointment
Reducing social contact to avoid feeling misunderstood or frustrated again

object_relations.self_representation: A business owner surrounded by pressure who must bear everything alone
object_relations.object_representation: Others who do not truly understand their situation and can hardly provide substantive help (friends / family)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes looking for counter-evidence, balancing the evidence, or suggests trying small self-care steps
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these suggestions are impractical, unable to understand the severity of the current situation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses a helpless, weary tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'the general environment is uncontrollable / it is not realistic now / there is no time', thereby negating and pushing away suggestions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or family provide support and advice and encourage sharing feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: They do not understand the severity of the matter, may belittle one's own worries
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gives brief answers, reduces details, avoids deeper exchange, or directly says 'they do not understand', then changes the topic.

manifestations: Reducing communication with friends and family due to stress
Believing others do not understand one's situation and anxiety, tending to bear it alone
outcomes: Anxiety and Sense of pressure intensifying
Increased helplessness and sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Attributes the feeling of 'being not understood' to others, believing support and advice are ineffective

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When invited to discuss positive evidence or self-care, shifts instead to emphasizing financial uncontrollability and powerlessness
Avoids present experience with vague responses such as 'maybe / uncertain / useless'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Reducing communication with friends out of worry about seeming to complain
Excessive restraint in expressing needs and seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing declining sales or thinking about economic uncertainty, the client usually catastrophizes and worries persistently, leading to poor sleep, decreased appetite, and affected work decisions.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On some days when business was better or when receiving positive comments from customers, the client did not fall into persistent catastrophizing as usual, but gained brief emotional relief and a sense of hope.
exception_events.reason: Different context / support: positive business feedback and customer recognition appeared, providing counter-evidence and emotional support in the short term, thereby interrupting the catastrophizing chain.

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends and family
Able to proactively brainstorm marketing strategies and promotion plans, having some capacity for action
Willing to seek help and start counseling; has motivation to change
The business still has 'good days' and positive customer feedback; usable positive evidence and resources exist
negative_force: Cognitive tendencies toward catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and predicting the future
External locus of control fallacy leads to a sense of powerlessness, weakening flexibility of action
Ignores or devalues positive information (selective attention to the negative)
Social withdrawal reduces support acquisition and intensifies isolation
Sleep and eating disturbances further impair mood and decision-making ability

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry about business decline and catastrophic thinking
antecedent: Sees a decline in the sales report
Thinking of the uncertainty of the economic environment
When alone, repeatedly recalls the worst-case scenario
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizes a short-term decline into a long-term trend, and uses 'expecting the worst' to gain a sense of control (control fallacy/catastrophizing)
target_behavior.function: Seeks a sense of safety and control by rehearsing the worst-case scenario in uncertain situations (to avoid unexpected blows)
target_behavior.consequence: Escalating anxiety, insomnia and decreased appetite, impaired attention and decision-making, further affecting work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (reduced communication with friends and family)
antecedent: Others offer suggestions or ask about recent circumstances
Worries about being seen as 'always complaining' or 'the other party does not understand'
target_behavior.core_reason: Attributes the experience of 'being misunderstood' to others; worries about exposing vulnerability and helplessness
target_behavior.function: Avoids interactions that might bring disappointment or being ignored, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Sources of support decrease, feelings of isolation intensify, negative emotions persist and worsen
